title: Counting Report Days after a Delivered Scan: Delivery Claims Carrier Calendar
content:
Carrier calendar note for Delivery Claims: on a Delivered Not Received or Lost in Transit Claim, the report days between the carrier's delivered date and the opening of the claim are counted on the days the delivery service delivers.

**Counting rule.** Those report days are counted only on the days the delivery service delivers: for a service that does not deliver on Saturdays, the counted days are the Monday-to-Friday days after the delivered date up to and including the date the claim was opened; for a service that delivers on Saturdays other than Same-Day Courier, the counted days are the Monday-to-Saturday days in that span; in every other case the counted days are the calendar days from the delivered date to the opening date.

Whether a delivery service delivers on Saturdays is that service's term in the Online Orders service schedule. The delivered date is the order's recorded delivered date; the opening date is the date the claim was opened.

| Order's delivery service | Days counted, after the delivered date up to and including the opening date |
|---|---|
| does not deliver on Saturdays | Monday to Friday |
| delivers on Saturdays, other than Same-Day Courier | Monday to Saturday |
| Same-Day Courier delivering on Saturdays, or any other case | every calendar day |

## Worked calendar (hypothetical: delivered on a Thursday, claim opened on the Tuesday 12 days later)

The span holds 12 calendar days: two Saturdays, two Sundays and eight Monday-to-Friday days.

| Service | Counted report days |
|---|---|
| does not deliver on Saturdays | 8 |
| delivers on Saturdays, not Same-Day Courier | 10 |
| Same-Day Courier delivering on Saturdays | 12 |
